# Robert's Portfolio

Master Researcher & Intelligence Officer for **Political Ascent**.

This portfolio is Robert's working space. Drafts, reference images, and compiled research live here before promotion to `docs/research/`.

---

## Research Packets (Team Resource)

Role-specific research packets for each team member, saved to `.github/team/research/`. These are curated knowledge bundles — domain best practices, genre references, internal doc pointers, and handoff conventions — tailored to each agent's specialization.

| File | Agent | Summary |
|------|-------|---------|
| [research-packet-sol.md](../../team/research/research-packet-sol.md) | **Sol** | TypeScript/React simulation architecture, Electron + Capacitor build pipeline, deterministic tick-engine patterns, save compatibility, Playwright integration |
| [research-packet-vex.md](../../team/research/research-packet-vex.md) | **Vex** | Narrative choice architecture, political drama voice, branching dialogue discipline, lore consistency, schema hygiene, historical register per scenario |
| [research-packet-rook.md](../../team/research/research-packet-rook.md) | **Rook** | Determinism testing for simulations, Playwright e2e patterns, Electron security (OWASP), accessibility gates, cross-platform artifact validation, balance-test scenarios |
| [research-packet-jesse.md](../../team/research/research-packet-jesse.md) | **Jesse** | Issue taxonomy for multi-agent workflows, milestone pacing, three-stream changelog discipline, bulk-edit script safety, wiki architecture, community communication |
| [research-packet-lux.md](../../team/research/research-packet-lux.md) | **Lux** | Gothic political UI visual language, design token architecture, faction color systems, information density in strategy UIs, WCAG contrast, reduced-motion design |
| [research-packet-nova.md](../../team/research/research-packet-nova.md) | **Nova** | Stock-and-flow simulation design, feedback loop governance, Victoria 3 / Democracy 4 / CK3 balance comparables, faction loyalty mechanics, explicit formula spec discipline |
| [research-packet-bridge.md](../../team/research/research-packet-bridge.md) | **Bridge** | Dispatcher vs. orchestrator patterns, dependency-ordered routing, context preservation in handoffs, ambiguity resolution, consolidation discipline |
| [research-packet-robert.md](../../team/research/research-packet-robert.md) | **Robert** | Research methodology, source evaluation, gap analysis, image curation standards, report format discipline, effort calibration |
